description: International Code of Signals maritime flags A–Z, each drawn in full color on canvas with its NATO meaning. Searchable.

faqs.a: The International Code of Signals (ICS) assigns one flag per letter, each with a standard single-letter meaning used worldwide at sea.
Every flag is drawn with canvas vector shapes — no images — at a crisp 3:2 ratio.
Yes — search by letter, phonetic name, or a word from the meaning (try 'diver' or 'pilot').

howto: Browse the full A–Z flag chart, or
search by letter, NATO name, or meaning.
Tap any card to copy its letter + meaning.
title: Nautical Flag Reference
